subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the pork stall in <Picture 1>: an indoor wet-market butcher counter at four in the morning — one long white-tiled counter lying east-west with cuts of raw pork and small yellow price cards on top, a metal bar above it with raw pork hanging from hooks, a dark wooden door in the pale tiled back wall, a string of red sausages on the east pier, five red umbrella-shaped pendant lamps in a row above the counter, white foam boxes, blue plastic crates and white buckets under the counter, and a wet terrazzo floor that reflects the red light.
<Subject 2> is the butcher in <Picture 1>: a stocky man in his forties with a round full face, a soft kindly look, a thick short neck, short black hair cropped close to the scalp, clean-shaven, wearing a dark navy-blue short-sleeve work shirt under a dark brown waterproof apron stained with dried blood and white knife scrapes.
<Subject 3> is the young customer in <Picture 1>: a slim young man in his early twenties with thick slightly messy short black hair, a longish face with a clean jawline and a small old scar just above the outer end of his left eyebrow, wearing a plain black crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, dark grey straight trousers and white low-top sneakers.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1] and fixes the stall, both men, the framing and the lighting.

The target video is a stylised 3D animated series look: cel-flat shading layered with volumetric light, clear transparent air, saturated but not harsh colours and a clean simple composition; the characters are rendered in a cartoon style with crisp outlines, layered shadows and finely drawn features.
GEOSPATIAL LOCK (identical in every shot of this scene): the stall sits on the NORTH side of the market aisle and FACES SOUTH, toward the aisle and the camera; x increases to the EAST, y increases to the NORTH. The counter lies east-west from x -1.5 to +1.5, y 0 to +0.8 (3.00 m long, 0.80 m deep, 0.90 m high); the pale tiled back wall runs x -1.8 to +1.8 at y +1.5 to +1.7 with one dark wooden door centred at x 0; 0.20 m thick piers stand at x +/-1.6 to +/-1.8; the string of red sausages hangs on the EAST pier at x +1.7, y +1.0; the five red pendant lamps hang in one row above the counter at y +0.4, at x -1.4, -0.7, 0, +0.7 and +1.4, all 2.40 m above the floor; the aisle beyond is y < 0 and about 3.5 m wide. <Subject 3> stands SOUTH of the counter at x -0.6, y -0.9, FACING NORTH. <Subject 2> stands NORTH of the counter at x +0.35, y +1.15, FACING SOUTH. The 180-degree axis is the line joining the two men's eyes; the camera stays on the SOUTH-EAST side of it at all times and never crosses the axis. The five red pendant lamps (about 3000 K) are the stall's ONLY light source, and the aisle behind the young man adds a faint cool spill at much lower intensity; every shadow falls almost straight down and slightly toward the back of the stall, soft-edged and low in contrast. The butcher stays on the EAST, frame-right side behind the counter and the young man stays on the WEST, frame-left side in front of it throughout; the two men never swap sides, never cross the counter, and neither man is ever duplicated or appears twice anywhere in the frame.
[Shot 1] A static medium-close shot, camera at eye level taken from the market aisle, framed tighter than a medium shot so that only the two men from the waist up, one section of the counter and part of the hanging meat fit inside the frame with a little air above their heads. From 0.0s to 1.2s <Subject 3> stands on the left looking at the meat. From 1.2s to 3.0s he leans his upper body far forward until his nose comes close to the strip of pork belly hanging on the bar, and he sniffs it while his eyes stay on <Subject 2>. From 3.0s to 4.5s he holds that leaning pose and only breathes. From 4.5s to 6.6s he keeps leaning but pulls his head back a little, still watching <Subject 2> with a doubtful, half-convinced look. Throughout, <Subject 2> keeps one hand resting on the counter top; at about 1.0s he raises his other hand and gestures once toward the hanging pork belly, at about 2.5s he lifts his chin and lets a small, easy smile form, and then he holds both. The hanging meat stays motionless, no steam is present, and the stall layout never changes. Lighting is practical and unmoving, exactly as locked above: the five red pendant lamps are the only light on the stall, the aisle behind the young man falls away into near-darkness with a single faint cool spill far in the background, and the wet floor bounces a faint warm fill upward onto the underside of the counter. The camera does not move, pan, zoom, tilt or cut at any point. The scene is quiet: no dialogue is spoken and nobody's lips move. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text appear at any point.

overall_soundscape:
A wet market at four in the morning, very quiet: a low electrical hum from the pendant lamps, the faint drip of water onto terrazzo somewhere down the aisle, one distant metallic clatter far away. Close by, only the young man's breathing and one soft scuff of a sneaker sole on the wet floor as he shifts his weight. No voices.
